description: Four marketplace references are offered to a client whose configured sources publish acme/weather-widget on both the `verified` and `community` trust channels. (1) A reference omitting trust_channel is refused TRUST_CHANNEL_UNKNOWN rather than defaulted: the trust channel is the provenance tier the install is accepted under (MKT-022, MKT-090), so a host picking one would be picking how much review the installed code has had, in the direction of whatever the registry currently offers. (2) A reference whose pack_id is the bare name `weather-widget` is refused CROSS_PACK_REFERENCE_UNQUALIFIED (MKT-008). (3) A reference naming a source the client has not configured is refused MARKETPLACE_REF_INVALID — a source is a client-configuration entry, never a caller-supplied location. (4) A well-formed reference for a pack_id no consulted source publishes an eligible entry for is refused MARKETPLACE_REF_UNRESOLVED, a distinct outcome from the malformed cases.
